name: Rozaliia (Roza) Russkikh

Created a reusable Angular component library for PXP partner portal with design tokens and form components to power the onboarding UI, and built REST API integrations to connect to .NET backend services
Collaborated directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring high-quality delivery and alignment with project goals
